name: open-research-index
description: Search papers, preprints, and formal proofs along with linked post-publication technical responses.

interface.shortDescription: Papers and proofs linked to technical responses
interface.longDescription: Open Research Index indexes papers, preprints, and formal proofs across AI-generated releases (OpenAI Math, agenticpapers.app, Hexagon), Lean formalization registries (Palomar), and this year's arXiv preprints in math, quant-ph, and hep-th. Records include linked post-publication technical responses (arXiv replies, blog posts, seminar talks, MathOverflow threads, and X posts) with author, date, verbatim excerpts, and source URLs. Read-only, no account required. Only responses linked in the index are returned; an empty response list means none have been linked yet.
defaultPrompt: What did mathematicians say about OpenAI's quasi-Riemann hypothesis paper?
Which AI-generated papers got expert responses most recently?
Has anyone checked OpenAI's matrix multiplication exponent paper?
